label: Options are Tier 1
subgoals: Search the existing options for the requested behavior
Express the request as an options or deck change
Verify the change by rerunning against golden values

label: Plug-ins at the device and integrator seams
section: Plug-ins at the device and integrator seams
subgoals: Identify the seam whose interface covers the requested behavior
Implement the behavior as a plug-in behind that seam
Batch plug-in calls to keep the hot loop efficient

label: Core edits to the solver
subgoals: Reserve core edits for changes to ordering, factorization, Newton or the time loop
Require full golden regression for every core edit
Redirect core proposals to an existing lower-tier seam when one fits
